members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id across the whole sidebar. Leaf ids are the sidebar's value.

members.name: label
members.doc: Row text. In the collapsed rail it moves to a tooltip.

members.name: icon
members.doc: Icon for a top-level row, about 18 px. Nested rows do not show one.

members.name: badge
members.doc: A count or short word at the end of the row.

members.name: href
members.doc: Renders the row as a link.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Keeps the row visible but not pressable.

members.name: children
members.doc: Nested rows. A row with children opens and closes its group instead of navigating.

members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id of the section.

members.name: title
members.doc: Small heading above the rows. In the rail it becomes a divider.

members.name: items
members.doc: The rows of the section.

types.name: AnimatedSidebarProps
types.doc: A sidebar with nested groups. Groups open with a height spring and their rows arrive one after another, one highlight glides under the pointer or keyboard focus, and the whole panel collapses to an icon rail where labels move into tooltips.

members.name: sections
members.doc: Sections of rows, top to bottom.

members.name: value
members.doc: Id of the active leaf row (controlled).

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Active row when uncontrolled.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the id of the pressed leaf row.

members.name: openIds
members.doc: Ids of the open groups (controlled).

members.name: defaultOpenIds
members.doc: Open groups when uncontrolled. Defaults to the group that holds the active row.

members.name: onOpenIdsChange
members.doc: Called with the next list of open group ids.

members.name: collapsed
members.doc: Whether the sidebar is the icon rail (controlled).

members.name: defaultCollapsed
members.doc: Starting state when uncontrolled.

members.name: onCollapsedChange
members.doc: Called when the collapse button is pressed, or when a group is opened from the rail.

members.name: logo
members.doc: Brand mark shown in the header.

members.name: title
members.doc: Product or workspace name shown beside the brand mark.

members.name: width
members.doc: Panel width in pixels.

members.name: collapsedWidth
members.doc: Rail width in pixels.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the sidebar.
